note: Musician handoff manifest (POST-BUILD MUSICIAN HANDOFF). Every cue below is emitted from the SAME real controller/rules path used by player actions and terminal outcomes. Emission core: core/rules_session.gd (RulesSession._push_cue at each real semantic site). Transport: RulesSession.consume_pending() (G6 3.3 {cues, events}) drained by app/screens/play.gd after every fixed 60Hz step and forwarded to app/cue_bus.gd (class_name CueBus, child of Main; emitted_log Array[Dictionary] for journey-contract observation). Dispatch slots (audio_director / announcer / juice_director) are compact replaceable no-op hooks until authored audio is supplied. No PCM ships in this tree and none is required.

transport.surface: core/rules_session.gd - RulesSession.consume_pending() returns {cues: [{cue_id, step}], events: [{type, step, position, entity_id, amount}]}
transport.bus: app/cue_bus.gd - CueBus.emit(cue_id, step) / emit_from_pending(pending); emitted_log for observation

cue.player.throw.meaning: Player fired the class projectile (throw action accepted and a projectile actually spawned; cooldown-gated presses emit nothing)

cue.player.potion.meaning: Player consumed one potion stock and the class potion effect activated

cue.player.hurt.meaning: Player took damage from any source (enemy contact, enemy projectile, or hazard tile; invulnerability-gated hits emit nothing)

cue.player.death.meaning: Player HP reached zero and the death countdown completed; terminal transition into DYING

cue.enemy.hurt.meaning: A player projectile damaged an enemy (per hit, including piercing hits)

cue.enemy.killed.meaning: An enemy died (projectile damage, potion AoE, splash, or generator-link death)

cue.generator.hurt.meaning: A player projectile damaged a spawn generator

cue.generator.destroyed.meaning: A spawn generator was destroyed; its live children die with it

cue.pickup.food.meaning: Player ate food and healed HP (the hall's clock stops bleeding for a moment)

cue.pickup.potion.meaning: Player collected a potion bottle (cap-3 inventory)

cue.pickup.chest.meaning: Player opened a chest and scored its value

cue.door.open.meaning: A locked door consumed one key and opened under the player

cue.floor.clear.meaning: Exit-door overlap held 3 consecutive frames on a floor below 24; terminal transition into FLOOR_RESULTS

cue.campaign.clear.meaning: Floor 24 cleared; terminal transition into CAMPAIGN_RESULTS

cue.continue.offered.meaning: Crumble animation finished; the continue offer opens (ring timer starts)

cue.continue.accepted.meaning: Continue accepted with tokens remaining; floor rebuilds from spawn

cue.continue.refused.meaning: Continue declined, or accepted with zero tokens; terminal transition into GAME_OVER
cue.continue.refused.callsite: core/rules_session.gd :: decide_continue(false) / decide_continue(true) with no tokens

cue.continue.expired.meaning: Continue ring timed out with no decision; terminal transition into GAME_OVER

cue.hp.tick.meaning: Hunger drain clock dealt integer HP damage (the heartbeat — fires on every integer decrement, not just lethal hits; juice-presentation cue for the drain pulse visual, no dedicated audio required)

cue.projectile.impact.meaning: Any projectile struck a valid target (enemy, generator, or player — fires alongside cue.enemy.hurt / cue.generator.hurt / cue.player.hurt; juice-presentation cue for the impact flash visual, no dedicated audio required)

cue.hazard.flame_preon.meaning: Flame-jet entered its fixed pre-ON warning window (flame_jet_preon_ticks before the damage phase). Presentation telegraph only — the damage window is unchanged; drives the G9 AC-39 pre-ON flicker.

cue.enemy.telegraph.meaning: Ranged enemy committed to a shot (demon/lobber/sorcerer fire). G9 §9 row 8 frames this as a ranged windup; the G2-locked rules have no windup state, so the cue fires at the fire moment — the only ranged-intent seam the locked runtime exposes (documented supersession, PROTOTYPE_BRIEF §6). Drives the G9 AC-37 telegraph modulate; sibling presentation event enemy_telegraph carries the entity id.
